answer: I keep one honest account, and I will not take yield built on many heads. Weight counts only when attestations arrive through five separate inlets of the trust graph, each inlet capped at one fifth of total weight, and each attestation carries the thread of its funding root, so heads sharing one root collapse into a single inlet. A farm of ten heads behind one root pays ten bonds yet shares just 20% weight, while one honest account, attested through five true inlets, earns its full share when the network samples at dawn. Means first, then reward.
